units.raw: `Several minutes pass after landing before the hull of the <ship> has cooled enough to make it safe for exit - despite Kaatrij's loaned technology, the ship's armor still glows red-hot. The interior of the garden's loading bay is cavernous, the tangled metal strands drawn inside onto giant spools each many meters in diameter.`

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 7|	Your crew gets to work under the supervision of Tiliia and Kaatrij's observer, removing small bits of metal from the rolls and carting them, one by one, onto the ship. Soon, Tiliia calls you over to a side section of the facility, and points out one of the spools - unlike the others, this one is entirely empty.|417|0

units.raw: `	Your crew gets to work under the supervision of Tiliia and Kaatrij's observer, removing small bits of metal from the rolls and carting them, one by one, onto the ship. Soon, Tiliia calls you over to a side section of the facility, and points out one of the spools - unlike the others, this one is entirely empty.`

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 7|	"Such a thing should not be. No House would've left a craft like that behind to molder, not for the sake of some petty metal. units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 7|	"Now we put this bounty to work, captain. units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 7|	Tiliia turns to go away but stops themself. "I've an apology to offer thee 'fore we part, captain," they say. "I showed thee some disrespect when we spoke before leaving. 'Tis strange to be accused by one so foreign to our ways. But we've been cut off a long time now, I think, hearing only from ourselves and the ghosts of others. Greater things are moving than either of us now, but thou mayst trust that I'll be careful with our treasure. I can promise thee nothing more, but thou'rt right to remind me of that, at least."|475|0
